title: Record the one later change of register 39
body:
## Summary
- From event 24284 through event 24437, register 39 has one scalar change when register 359 starts at `1`. Event 24284 takes it from `-2` to `-4`.
- The other 153 scalar events in that window leave the value at `-4`. The data register contributes `0`. At the literal magnitude `256`, the held value is `-1024`.
- No selected frontier change and no new exponent. Event 24438 is not applied.
